claim: R-033: a changed-premise, production-owned significant-sound observation can be bound from a real staged source to an abstract structural watcher and through one identity-continuous local/abstract return, without crediting setup.
material_proof: The bound disposable run first records the exact prepared idle camp, source/executable, observer-member IDs, route generation, and simulation owner. The staged explosive and all fixture preparation are zero-credit. Credit requires later native evidence that the real source emitted, the abstract watcher consumed that source on the production sound callback with its exact source/current OMT and no competing field signal, and any returned sound lead is bound to the same run. The local/abstract route is credited only where its exact members, generation, waypoint and owner transitions are natively recorded without duplicate or simultaneous advancement.
current_uncertainty: Whether the prepared structural sortie reaches the declared watch before the source, whether the subsequent callback accepts the real source, and whether the return retains the same member and owner identities through the loaded/abstract boundary.
material_contradiction: the source is fabricated by direct sound, lead, report, operation, or member-state injection
the native callback lacks exact source/current OMT, sound event, watcher, or run/executable binding
a claimed returned lead lacks matching source provenance or is present before the source callback
a claimed boundary transition changes member identity or route generation, or permits dual local/abstract ownership
the stage/setup is treated as a gameplay observation or response
forbidden_shortcuts: direct signal, lead, report, operation, contact, or member mutation
raw save rewrite after fixture installation
crediting fixture preparation or staged explosive placement as observation
honest_stop_conditions: finish after the first source-bound sound callback and the first available exact owner-transition/returned-lead result
finish inconclusive if the route does not reach the declared watcher/source causal boundary under its recorded footing
finish contradicted if a run-bound source, callback, lead, or owner identity violates the stated invariants
